svg.title: Fluid editor parity
svg.desc: 80 of 118 items done, 38 partial, 0 open, 0 unknown. Harness and oracle: 11 of 12 done. Published grid CSS: 13 of 13 done. Page and site context: 5 of 8 done. Block types: 6 of 15 done. Geometry and snapping: 8 of 8 done. Gestures: 8 of 13 done. Row stretch: 3 of 5 done. Text editing: 4 of 7 done. Overlap and layers: 5 of 5 done. Phone layout: 6 of 8 done. Section settings and Stacks: 1 of 4 done. Editor chrome: 5 of 12 done. History, save and publish: 3 of 5 done. Accessibility and order: 2 of 3 done.
svg.text: Everything that has to match Fluid Engine, one cell per item.
unknown: needs a trace on the oracle before it can be built
